textRuns.value: Every change, view, download, login and configuration edit in Genesys Cloud is written to the audit log. A daily pipeline exports each UTC day to a JSON file; this report loads those files and turns them into a star model: one row per audit event, one row per changed property, and dimensions for date, user, OAuth client, service, action and entity type. Genesys stores times in UTC; the report shows Australia/Sydney time with daylight saving applied, and each daily file covers one Sydney day (midnight to midnight).
